page.title: Shared data
page.intro: Tables your agents share. Every agent can read every table, so private notes belong in an agent's memory, not here.
page.details: The agent that made a table adds and changes its rows freely; another agent's changes follow your approval rules for that agent (removing rows always asks you). Only the maker can reshape or delete a table, and deleting always asks you.

empty: No tables yet. When an agent makes one, it shows up here.
